capabilities: Persist list-item fold state as marker lines in the note
Hide marker lines in Live Preview, Source mode and Reading view
Fold and unfold items via commands and a hover button
Re-apply folds after external rewrites or syncs of the file
Support configurable marker styles (Logseq, HTML comment, Obsidian comment, custom)
disambiguation: Not a Logseq importer, exporter or sync tool; it only writes and reads Logseq-style fold markers inside Obsidian notes.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is by manual file copy or BRAT; no community-plugin-store listing is described. Author feedback channel is Twitter (@Matsurimywaifu).
intentEvidence: The folding itself is not drawn by this plugin — it calls the same CodeMirror fold that ⌥S uses.
motivation: The author wanted fold state to live in the file rather than in external storage, because a JSON file keyed by line numbers or hashes breaks when notes are rewritten, while a line in the note travels with its content through git, sync and export.
problem: Obsidian forgets list folds when a note is closed, and Logseq-imported vaults show the collapsed:: true property as plain text.

relations.evidence: Logseq stores a folded block as a collapsed:: true property right under it.
Or add it through BRAT from MatsuriMW/logseq-style-fold.

summary: List-folding plugin that remembers each item's folded state by writing a Logseq-style collapsed:: true marker line into the note itself.
